answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the haven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the quill until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ferrous of the next round. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission.
